name: Bague Mariana
ligne: À l’origine de la bague Mariana, il y a un bouquet, un dôme de diamants ronds de calibres variés, éparpillés et chacun tenu dans ses griffes.
description: Bague Mariana, or blanc, jaune ou rose 750/1000, sertie de diamants ronds.
details: Or blanc 750 ‰, Or jaune 750 ‰, Or rose 750 ‰

en.ligne: The Mariana ring began as a bouquet, a dome of round diamonds in mixed sizes, scattered and each held in its own claws.
en.description: Mariana ring in 18ct white, yellow or rose gold, set with round diamonds.

it.ligne: All’origine dell’anello Mariana c’è un bouquet, una cupola di diamanti rotondi di varie misure, sparsi e ciascuno montato a griffe.
it.description: Anello Mariana in oro bianco, giallo o rosa 18 kt, con diamanti rotondi.
